title: Cyber Crime Awareness
summary: A Cyber Crime Awareness session was conducted at Chandulal Nanavati Vinay Mandir for 243 students of Classes 7, 8 and 9.
description: A Cyber Crime Awareness session was conducted at Chandulal Nanavati Vinay Mandir for 243 students of Classes 7, 8 and 9. Mr Rajendra Tawate, Associate Mumbai Police, conducted an interactive session covering various types of cyber frauds through real-life examples and PPTs. Students learned about cyber-related terminology, protecting social media accounts, identifying authentic OTP links, helpline numbers for reporting cyber fraud, cyber arrest and POCSO in relation to cyber crime. An interactive Q&A session addressed day-to-day cyber-related concerns faced by students and their families.
location: Chandulal Nanavati Vinay Mandir, Mumbai, Maharashtra
